summary_zh: 瀑布從石頭層流出來，造型非常的漂亮，流出的瀑布如天空藍綠色非常漂亮，但有時來可能會遇上泥水漿，加上開進來單趟要近 50 分鐘，可以衡量旅程來規畫。  另外如果上游有下雨，這瀑布的水可能呈現如泥漿的顏色，所以前來這裡要有心裡上預期不理想。  旁邊步行 3 分鐘，還有一個「小孩瀑布 Barnafoss」 可以一起納進來。
summary_en: The waterfall emerges from a rocky layer, featuring a striking shape and sky‑blue/green water, though you may sometimes encounter muddy flow. The drive to the site takes about 50 minutes one way, so plan your itinerary accordingly; after rain upstream the water can appear muddy, so manage expectations. Paid parking and a viewing platform are available on site, and a short 3‑minute walk leads to the nearby “Barnafoss” (Children’s Waterfall), which can be added to your visit.
